task_2_admin_secured_with_password.details: /admin requires password login. Login gate shows password input + 'Se connecter' button. Saturn5858* works, admin123 rejected with 401.

task_3_admin_premium_secured_with_passwo.details: /admin-premium requires password login. Shows 'Admin Premium' title + 'Acces securise' + password input. Saturn5858* logs in successfully.

task_4_hotspots_v3_in_admin_premium.details: Full Hotspots BIONIC V3 module accessible via 'Terres/Hotspots' sidebar in Admin Premium. Contains: Extraction button, Map/Table toggle, Filters, GeoJSON/JSON exports, BCE-4X report, Stats.

task_5_territorial_data.details: Hotspots include enriched data: territory_type (7 types), access_status (4 statuses), ville, code_postal, altitude_m, GPS coordinates, gestionnaire info.

task_6_gestionnaire_access.details: Gestionnaire panel shows contact info for ZEC/Pourvoiries/Reserves (nom, tel, courriel, web). 'Contacter le gestionnaire du territoire' button present.

task_7_annual_scheduler.details: POST /api/v1/admin/bionic-hotspots/scheduler/run extracts 300 hotspots from 12 regions. Returns BCE-4X PASS report (1200/1200) and next_scheduled (year+1).
